title: Affine perfect extension after adjoining a shift
statement: Let X be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], let U be a quasi-compact open of X, and let F be a perfect object of D(\mathcal O_U) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-perfect-complex]. Then there exists a perfect object E of D(\mathcal O_X) whose restriction to U is isomorphic to F \oplus F[1].

proof.text: By [lem-sc-affine-perfect-plus-locally-free], choose an integer r, a finite locally free module \mathcal F on U, and a perfect object E of D(\mathcal O_X) whose restriction is isomorphic to \mathcal F[-r]\oplus F.

source.place: Tag 08EI proof, first paragraph, invoking Tag 08ED

proof.text: Apply [lem-sc-perfect-qcoherent] to the perfect object P from Step 1, giving an object of D_QCoh with underlying object P. Conjugate the projection id on the shifted locally free summand and zero on F by the restriction isomorphism. Apply [lem-sc-affine-perfect-map-lift] with source P and target this quasi-coherent object to obtain a perfect A and a map gamma:A to P, together with an isomorphism b_U:R(A) to R(P) satisfying alpha=b_U inverse followed by R(gamma). Multiplying by b_U gives R(gamma)=b_U followed by alpha.

source.place: Tag 08EI proof, second paragraph, invoking Tag 08EH

proof.text: By TR1 [def-weil-triangulated-category], complete gamma to a distinguished triangle A to P to E to A[1]. Apply [lem-pc-perfect-two-out-of-three] to obtain perfectness of E. Exact derived restriction [def-pc-derived-category] sends this to a distinguished triangle whose first arrow, under b_U and the isomorphism of Step 1, is the projection onto the shifted locally free summand.

Compute that projection cone in the private proved helper cone_projection_iso. Start with the contractible triangle M to M to 0. The existing source-library theorem CategoryTheory.Pretriangulated.mk_fst_comp_distinguished adjoins F to the source, giving first arrow M direct sum F to M. Then mk_comp_inl_distinguished adjoins F to the target, giving first arrow the projection endomorphism on M direct sum F and third term (0 direct sum F[1]) direct sum F. Mathlib isoTriangleOfIso12 extends the two given isomorphisms to an isomorphism of distinguished triangles, using TR3 [def-weil-triangulated-category] and [lem-sf-triangle-morphism-iso]. Project to the third term, remove the zero summand, and exchange the two summands. The result is R(E) isomorphic to F direct sum F[1]. The two padding results are already proved in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Triangulated.Triangulated, lines 50 and 113; no new unproved statement is introduced.
